body: Commit 5e2840f (+ CHANGELOG). arena_bot_tick's movement now calls rl_policy_forward() from a real, fully-trained 1M-timestep PPO policy (30W/0L/0D eval over 30 episodes vs the heuristic bot AI), replacing the old hand-picked-weight bot_brain_forward(). Caught and fixed a real circular-dependency bug: arena_update's own automatic bot-tick would have made training's own opponent driven by whatever policy is currently compiled in. Fixed 5 existing tests broken by the now-effective bot movement. Verified live twice under Xvfb (interim + final model) -- real mutual combat engagement. Full suite green.
title: S170-228: trained RL policy wired into the live bot AI
